summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with a parametrized test plus a None/plain-string test. test_shacl.py and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed) under the prepared venv. Only the two new files are added; nothing committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by hand only (no lines over 88 columns).
